title: Mother's Day at Jetty Road Brewery
summary: A looser Mother's Day option in Dromana, running from 11am to 9pm and better suited to families who want the day to feel easy rather than ceremonial.
description: Jetty Road Brewery is running a Mother's Day event on Sunday 10 May 2026 from 11am to 9pm. It is the simpler north-side version of the day: easier access, a more relaxed atmosphere, and enough flexibility that lunch can blur into the afternoon without feeling overplanned.
kidsGradeNote: Family-usable, especially if you want something casual rather than dressy, but it is still fundamentally a hospitality booking.
editorVerdict: The easiest Mother's Day booking for the northern side of the Peninsula. Less polished than a winery lunch, but often more forgiving in real life.
editorNote: Jetty Road Brewery is the useful option when the family wants Mother's Day to feel relaxed rather than reverent. Dromana is easier to get in and out of than the southern end, the time window is broad, and the brewery format gives you more margin if people arrive late, leave early, or decide lunch should become most of the afternoon.
